settings.entry: Buy stop at the pivot, valid 5 sessions after the setup day
settings.stop: Structural stop clamped to 3%-8% below the fill
settings.exit: First close below the 50-day SMA (21-day EMA once up 20%), or session 252
settings.sizing: 1% account risk per trade, position capped at 25%
settings.signal: Each setup (ticker, setup day, family) counts once
